page.overview:
Who is Diver?

After the Decepticon Pretenders were sealed away, the Autobot Pretenders went their separate ways. Diver eventually came to live in the United States and worked as a marine biologist in California.

Diver later on explained to Hydra and Buster Pretenders' role and why they chose to reside on Earth, but his speech was taken by the Darkwing brothers as sappy and worthless. Soon after, Diver was facing near-certain death when he was saved by a re-energized Ginrai fusing with his Transtector.

Diver summoned Lander to the California so that he could educate Ginrai on the Decepticons, and although Ginrai was not willing to formally join the Autobots, he agreed to help them when he could "for the sake for the world." Unfortunately for Ginrai, the Decepticons began targeting truckers in an attempt to find him, causing the deaths of several of his friends. When the villains at last tracked Ginrai down, Diver had to remind Ginrai of the correct activation code so that he could transform and beat the Decepticons back. Ginrai: God On of Rage!!

When Ginrai discovered three more pairs of Master-Braces in his Transtector, Diver arranged for him to bring them to the Autobot base in Japan for study. A Strange Friendship: Cancer and Minerva While there, Ginrai discovered a trailer for his Transtector, and returned to America to show it to Diver and Lander. Ginrai proceeded to appear on TV in hopes of finding the Godmasters-to-be that the new Master-Braces will belong to, while Diver and Lander tried to take his outlandish approach in stride. Soon after his TV appearance, Ginrai was attacked by Hydra and Buster in an attempt to publicly disgrace him, but Diver and Lander came to his aid and took care of the Seacons the brothers had brought with them. In the wake of the battle, Diver commented that if Ginrai was already so self-conscious as to be concerned for his reputation, then he was already a good candidate for Autobot leader. Eliminate the Godmaster Ginrai
